# Computer Vision Inference Pipelines

## Overview

The YOLO model is one part of a bigger system:

1. capture a frame from camera or video stream
2. run a detector / segmenter / pose **model** (YOLO)
3. post-process predictions
4. track objects across frames
5. render or trigger downstream actions

In practice, computer vision is therefore both a **modeling** problem and a **systems** problem.

## Roboflow Inference Library

[Inference](https://inference.roboflow.com/start/overview/) is Roboflow's open-source hub for **deploying computer vision systems**.

Instead of wiring every serving detail by hand, it gives you a reusable layer for:

::: {.incremental}
1. model **serving** (client-server communication)
2. **Workflow** execution (business logic)
3. **video stream** handling (I/O)
4. **pre/post-processing** (per-frame logic)
5. **CPU/GPU** optimization (performance)
:::


::: {.fragment}
::: {.callout}
**Big idea:** you focus on the application logic (**Workflow**), while `Inference` handles the rest.
:::
:::

### Components

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[1. `inference-sdk`](https://inference.roboflow.com/inference_helpers/inference_sdk/)**

Lightweight Python client for talking to an Inference Server over HTTP.
:::
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[2. `inference-cli`](https://inference.roboflow.com/inference_helpers/inference_cli/)**

Command-line entry point for setup, management, and common server tasks.
:::
::::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[3. Inference Server](https://inference.roboflow.com/quickstart/docker/)**

Docker-based HTTP service that exposes models and Workflows as an API.
:::
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[4. `inference` package](https://inference.roboflow.com/using_inference/about/)**

Core Python runtime for loading models and executing Workflow logic.
:::
::::

## Core Runtime

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[Model serving](https://inference.roboflow.com/quickstart/run_a_model)**

- Run object detection, classification, segmentation, keypoints, OCR, VQA, and more.
- Works with [pre-trained](https://inference.roboflow.com/quickstart/aliases), [fine-tuned](https://roboflow.com/train), and selected [foundation](https://inference.roboflow.com/foundation/about) models.
:::
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[Video streaming](https://inference.roboflow.com/workflows/video_processing/overview)**

- Use `InferencePipeline` for cameras, RTSP feeds, and video files with frame management built in.
:::
::::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[Speed](https://inference.roboflow.com/understand/features#speed)**

- Benefit from parallelization, hardware acceleration, dynamic batching, and optional TensorRT paths.
:::
::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
**[Extensibility](https://inference.roboflow.com/understand/features#extensibility)**

- The stack is open source, so you can add custom models, custom Workflow blocks, and new backends.
:::
::::

## Deploy anywhere

The deployment question is **where should it run?**

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%" .fragment}
**[Serverless](https://docs.roboflow.com/deploy/serverless-hosted-api-v2)**

**Best for:** simple request-response inference with spiky demand.

**Billing:** per call ([metered](https://roboflow.com/pricing)).
:::
::: {.column width="33%" .fragment}
**[Dedicated](https://docs.roboflow.com/deploy/dedicated-deployments)**

**Best for:** heavier models and steadier production workloads.

**Billing:** hourly VM.
:::
::: {.column width="33%" .fragment}
**[Self-hosted](https://inference.roboflow.com/install/)**

**Best for:** local hardware, offline operation, and strict infrastructure control.

**Billing:** your own stack. See the [install guide](https://inference.roboflow.com/install/).
:::
::::

::: {.fragment}
All three support **fine-tuned models**, **pre-trained models**, and **Workflows**.

See also: [What devices can I use?](https://inference.roboflow.com/quickstart/devices/)
:::
